title: Research and level proposals
current: /yoke models step 0 runs yoke update --check, which reports the installed CLI, the active server engine and the channel latest with behind cli|server|none and a destination-specific next step: local updates CLI and server together with yoke update, a self-hosted server is upgraded by its admin, hosted servers update with each hosted release. It then offers yoke universe levels reset when the universe or a project stores its own levels. yoke models level-proposal prints each level as model min_effort rows, lists placeable unplaced models separately from unplaceable ones that publish no efforts, and names reset as the apply command when the proposal equals the shipped defaults; any other approved document is stored with set, which stops following future shipped defaults.
